newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 17. [CORRECTED 12:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Feb 17. [CORRECTED 12:40 GMT]

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Socialist party secretary Lionel Jospin calls on Prime Minister Alain Juppe to back down on part of a government bill toughening controls on illegal immigration.
(Corrects to remove erroneous reference to Jospin calling for withdrawal of bill.)

-- Societe Generale to file complaint against latest 3.9 billion franc state help to loss-making state-owned bank Credit Lyonnais and authorized by EU authorities. The paper adds that Britain also has complained about planned further French state help estimated at up to 30 billion francs ahead of a Lyonnais privatisation.
-- Insurers AGF and GAN may become choice targets for European insurers aiming for growth, provided GAN recapitalisation allows it to write off its exposure to property crisis.
